- nda-17: Permissible copy - [25] "make no copies thereof" - no copies allowed at all, so hypothesis "may create a copy in some circumstances" - Contradiction, evidence [25]. Also [34] "must not be copied". Evidence [25].
- nda-8: Notice on compelled disclosure - Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-13: Permissible acquirement of similar information - Not mentioned. NotMentioned.
- nda-5: Sharing with employees - Not mentioned (no provision about sharing with own employees). NotMentioned.
- nda-4: Limited use - [25] "use it solely for the purpose as agreed between parties." Entailment, evidence [25].
